page.overview:
Who is Aloysius' brother?

A Houk brother was a criminal who, alongside Aloysius and another brother, went after the Zeltron criminal Samu Mavolak after he cheated in a game of Sabacc with them. After cornering Mavolak and threatening to harm his son on the world Meddan, the bounty hunter Boba Fett, who was also hunting Mavolak, swept in and killed the Houk along with their kin.

Aloysius' brother appeared in the second issue of the 2025 comic miniseries Star Wars: Boba Fett — Black, White & Red. The issue was written by Saladin Ahmed, illustrated by Ramon Rosanas, and published by Marvel Comics
